unresolvedFindings.summary: TP-B005-006 cannot be authored as specified. The row asks for a browser assertion that a stale-only workspace renders the allocation lab without an uncaught RangeError, but the repaired rlportfolio.deriveInterestSignals is reachable only through buildInterestSignalCandidate, whose only callers repository-wide are tests/portfolio-foundation.unit.mjs:1044, :1904 and tests/portfolio-privacy.functional.mjs:1704. Such a row would therefore pass identically against pre-fix source — a tautological regression the repository's own guardrails forbid. bubbles.test refused to author it rather than manufacture false browser confidence. Reachability is reasoned from executed greps over a complete static call graph, not from a runtime probe; that uncertainty is declared at report.md#test-phase-coverage-gap.
